page.layout: One page of text in a single column; running head at the top; faint show-through text in the right margin (from the facing page) and the digitiser's caption at the foot, which are not transcribed.

main_text.p: quod hi affectant (& non ferendum est) hoc Philomusi illi & mortuorum socii, præter animi sui sententiam patiuntur (& ignoscendum est) ut nimirum distractâ sæpè atque in museio plusquam semirelictâ mente, in publicum prodeuntes, amicorum occursus non percipiant, eosque velut ignotos prætereant, aut impensè officiosis tantum frigidè respondeant: Itaque in sermonem incidunt & vapulant: nam habet ista suspicio neglecti officii, acre quid & mordax, quod acerbam ex intervallo vellicat, nec sopiri patitur memoriam: scilicet turpis repulsæ speciem habet, si quem ambibat salutans, is resalutâdo non deferatur honos: Atqui à tam futili caussa sæpè compertum est provenire, ut boni doctique viri, ubi pro meritis amari se putant, maledicorum qui-

page.notes: Right margin carries faint marginal notes from the facing page, too indistinct to read; not transcribed. Text is an ordinary running paragraph ending mid-word "qui-" (catchword/continuation on next page). Some words slightly blurred; "distractâ", "relictâ" and "resalutâdo" read as printed. Possible printing irregularity: "museio" as printed.
